patterns: Streaming and Disney+ release news led the board: FilmUpdates' 'THE BODY debuts with 100% on Rotten Tomatoes. Now streaming on Netflix' hit 2,584,109 views, the top post of the day, and DiscussingFilm's 'AVENGERS ENDGAME: ENCORE will release on Disney+ this Friday' did 2,472,151. Short, factual, one-line announcements again beat long copy.
Renewals travel on both news accounts: 'ADULTS has been renewed for season 3' pulled 2,140,132 views with 82,895 likes on FilmUpdates (the most-liked post of the day) and 555,141 on DiscussingFilm.

DC Studios fallout is the new storyline: Frank Grillo's video about James Gunn and Peter Safran leaving DC Studios did 1,498,863 on DiscussingFilm, and Francis Lawrence saying he is 'more hopeful' about CONSTANTINE 2 now that they've left added 777,144.

Doomsday and Star Wars ran the morning: Empire's new look at AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY 407,334, extra writing credits for Reynolds, Jackman and Cretton 426,627, Cyclops and Magneto 188,210, and 60K+ opening-night pre-sales 202,325. The STAR WARS 50th anniversary re-release poster did 485,338, the logo reveal with John Williams 333,490, and the LEGO Star Wars poster 313,432.

Games and gossip crossed over: Marvel 1943 'reportedly light on actual gameplay' 1,776,433, 'GTA 6 releases in ONE WEEK' 906,658 with 66,420 likes, Mike Myers calling SHREK 5 the best in the franchise 1,071,243, and Tarantino on firing Isabelle Huppert from Inglourious Basterds 843,280 (only 1,445 likes, so it was read more than liked).

Smaller accounts win with anniversaries, re-releases and audience prompts: CinemaTweets1's Tracy Letts appreciation post did 57,235 (about 4x its usual) and The Departed's 20th-anniversary re-release worked for both DiscussingFilm (439,018) and CinemaTweets1 (14,049 and 12,348). ATRightMovies' best were 'Name a one-liner from a 1980s movie that everyone will know' (45,641) and a media-only clip (45,084).
narrative_synthesis: Streaming news ran the day: THE BODY's 100% Rotten Tomatoes debut on Netflix hit 2,584,109 views on FilmUpdates, the top post on the board, with AVENGERS ENDGAME: ENCORE coming to Disney+ close behind at 2,472,151 on DiscussingFilm and the ADULTS season 3 renewal at 2,140,132. The new storyline is DC Studios after James Gunn and Peter Safran: Frank Grillo's tribute did 1.50M and the Constantine 2 reaction 777K. Morning traffic went to Empire's Avengers: Doomsday looks (up to 427K) and the Star Wars 50th anniversary (poster 485K, logo 333K). CinemaTweets1's Tracy Letts post (57,235) was the smaller-account outlier. @RealEmirHan had no originals in the window.
